summary: Wecom LLC is the one active operating company. Searchlight controls it through the SFA-Topco-Holdco chain. Epsom/GIC and Platinum/ADIA each hold 46.74% nonvoting interests in SFA, corresponding to FCC-reported 36.38% indirect Holdco interests; neither percentage is a direct Wecom stake. Simple Broadband and founders retain supported Topco interests. No later ownership transfer or pending deal was found.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The exact May 2023 closing day and license-assignment consummation date are not publicly disclosed.
GIC/ADIA entry dates and any post-August 2024 upstream cap-table change are not publicly disclosed.
Prior Wecom LLC owner treatment, Wecom Inc./Data-Max status and customer/route-mile counts remain unresolved.
